description: This PHP source file defines the "Authorize" controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages account authorization processes such as login verification, token management, two-factor authentication, and account unlock procedures. The class contains methods for displaying authorization pages, sending verification codes, saving authorization data, resetting authorization attempts, confirming authorization links, and unlocking accounts.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class handling user account authorization, token management, and security procedures.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the authorization page, generating or verifying tokens, and preparing data for view rendering.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles sending verification codes to customers, managing redirect logic based on login and token status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of authorization data, verifying codes, updating attempt totals, and redirecting upon success.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles account unlock requests, resets authorization tokens, and renders the unlock view.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Generates a token for account confirmation links and responds with success or redirect instructions.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Performs account unlocking by verifying email and code, resetting tokens, logging out users, and rendering unlock page.
